news.title: Arkadian Strategic Metals, ACG, Pantheon Resources, Buccaneer Energy, IXICO, Allergy Therapeutics
news.summary:
Arkadian Strategic Metals PLC (AIM:AKN, OTC:ALBAF) is processing a further 1.7 tonnes of floor material at its Clogau-St David’s gold mine in north Wales. An initial 100kg sample recovered 0.81 grams of gold.

ACG Metals Ltd (LSE:ACG, OTC:ACGAF) has issued $325 million of bonds to repay its existing $200 million bond. The balance will help fund its Gediktepe copper mine in Türkiye.

Pantheon Resources PLC (AIM:PANR, OTCQX:PTHRF) has raised £7.5 million, about 50% more than it first sought. That funds it into the third quarter of 2027 while it looks for a partner on Alaska’s North Slope.

Buccaneer Energy Plc (AIM:BUCE) has raised a further £76,763 from retail investors, taking its total to nearly £587,000. It’s restoring full production at its Pine Mills oilfield in Texas.

IXICO PLC (LSE:IXI, OTC:PHYOF) has developed an AI tool to spot brain microbleeds in Alzheimer’s patients on new drugs. On average, it detected about 90% of microbleeds in each scan.

Allergy Therapeutics PLC (AIM:AGY, OTC:AGYTF) plans to cancel its AIM listing and go private. Shareholders vote on the 14th of December, and the two largest holders have said they’ll back it.
